title: repository-progress-view
description: A read-only Control Center projection of one GitHub repository's milestone and issue progress, for the AWCMS 'Progres Hermes' view (issue #249, split from #246 part 2). GitHub remains the sole authority for this observation (AGENTS.md: 'GitHub owns repository, workflow, release, and deployment observations'); AWCMS polls the GitHub REST API on a schedule (ADR-0030) and produces this tenant-scoped shape, stamped with observed_at so a stale projection can be rendered as stale rather than silently presented as current. It carries no issue bodies, no comments, and no assignee/author PII - only what a milestone/issue progress board needs: numbers, titles, state, label names, and derived kind. additionalProperties=false at every object level makes 'no raw shell/command escape hatch anywhere in this schema' structural (registry guard C1, lib/omes/py/architecture/registry.py), matching every other contracts/control-center/v1 schema.

tenant_id.description: The AWCMS tenant this projection is scoped to.

repository.description: The GitHub repository this projection observes.

owner.description: The GitHub account/organization login that owns the repository.

name.description: The repository name (without the owner prefix).

html_url.description: The repository's github.com URL. Restricted to https://github.com/ so no other host can be smuggled in as an authoritative source link.

observed_at.description: When AWCMS's polling job last successfully fetched this data from the GitHub REST API. A consumer compares this against its own freshness policy (ADR-0030) to decide whether to render the projection as fresh or stale.

source.description: How this observation was produced. 'github_rest_poll' is the only implemented path (ADR-0030). 'github_webhook' is reserved for a possible later optimization that reuses the existing lib/omes/py/domains/github.py HMAC verifier to refresh a projection sooner than the poll interval; a webhook delivery would still need a poll-based backfill for gaps and initial population, so it is additive, never a replacement for polling.

milestones.description: Open and recently-closed milestones, newest-relevant first. Never includes milestone descriptions (free-form provider text) - title only.

number.description: The milestone number (GitHub's own identifier, stable and public).

due_on.description: GitHub's due_on timestamp, or null when the milestone has no due date.

issues.description: Open and recently-updated issues, bounded per poll. Never includes an issue body, comments, or assignee/author identity - see the schema description.

labels.description: Label names only (no color, description, or id).

milestone_number.description: The owning milestone's number (cross-referencing milestones[].number), or null when the issue is not assigned to a milestone.

kind.description: Derived deterministically from the issue's labels at projection time (never invented): 'epic' for a type:epic label, 'feature' for type:feature/enhancement, 'bug' for bug/type:bug, 'docs' for documentation/type:documentation, 'other' otherwise. See ADR-0030 for the exact mapping.
